employer_match.formula_readable: Capital One matches 100% of the first 3% of eligible pay contributed, and 50% of the next 3% of eligible pay contributed, for a maximum matching contribution of 4.5% of eligible pay. To receive the maximum match, an associate must contribute at least 6% of eligible pay. A true-up matching contribution may be provided at year-end for participants who did not receive the full match during the year; to be eligible, the associate must be actively employed on December 31 (except in cases of retirement, permanent disability, death, or job elimination).

nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: Capital One automatically contributes 3% of eligible pay to each eligible associate's account each pay period, regardless of whether the associate is actively contributing to the Plan. Associates are 100% vested in these contributions immediately.

eligibility.formula_readable: You are eligible for the Associate Savings Plan if you are at least 18 years of age and are a full-time or part-time associate of Capital One or an affiliate that has adopted the Plan. Participation begins on your first day of work.

employee_contributions.formula_readable: Employees are always 100% vested in their own Associate Elective Contributions (pre-tax, Roth, and catch-up), pre-2008 after-tax contributions, and rollover contributions immediately.

immediate_vest_triggers: Reaching age 65 while an active associate
Becoming permanently and totally disabled during the plan year
employer_match.formula_readable: Employees become 100% vested in Matching Company Contributions after completing two years of service. Before two years of service, employees are 0% vested and forfeit unvested matching contributions upon leaving. Employees also become 100% vested immediately upon reaching age 65, becoming permanently and totally disabled, or dying during the plan year.

nonelective.formula_readable: The 3% Basic Non-Elective Company Contributions (safe-harbor non-elective contributions) vest immediately, along with earnings on those contributions.
